summary: The task — show the implementation LLM for not-yet-started proposal/prompt tasks on the bottom-left of the editor and allow picking another via dropdown — is implemented correctly and minimally. PendingTaskModelSelect is rendered only when task.status === 'pending', is placed in ProposalDetail's bottom action row before the flex-1 spacer (left-aligned), reuses the composer's LlmConfigSelect for visual consistency (allowDefault={false} since the per-task override is always a concrete config), and PATCHes /api/tasks/:id with the chosen llmConfigId. The backend extends patchBodySchema with an optional min(1) llmConfigId, verifies ownership+enabled through the new shared findOwnedLlmConfig (extracted from the previously-duplicated query in task-model-handlers.ts per §6), and only writes the field when present so the stored override is preserved when the field is absent. The display falls back to effectiveLlmConfigId when llmConfigId is null (inherited default), so the trigger always surfaces the model that will run. New locking tests cover the schema, the 200/400/404 paths, the 'do not touch llmConfigId when field is absent' path (backend), the trigger-content and inherited-default fallback (frontend), and the hook's PATCH body + invalidations + toast suppression. Backend build + 1459 tests green; frontend build + 518 tests green. Only nit: two unrelated files (ConsoleFooterStatusBar.tsx, console-footer.test.ts) get a trailing-newline touched up — harmless and not blocking.
